notes.title: Weeee who could have foreseen this? (v1.06 notes)
notes.content:
So turns out that when shipping 26 games at the same time, some bugs MIGHT go unnotice; WHO WOULD'VE THOUGHT.

First round of issues being fixed this week, a lot of the bugs reported so far are like, deep engine stuff, like things that were bugged 10 years ago and left as is; we might not ever be able to fix them, but we'll try, good lord we'll try.
[list]
[*]Fixed possible connection issue in BattleCry
[*]Fixed possible connection issue in SkyQuest
[*]Fixed Gunbot coins that wasn't rewarded during gameplay
[*]Audio options properly loads in Gunbot
[/list]
Thanks to everyone who reported issues, if you run into any more, please send any report to [b]troublemakeitdouble@berzerkstudio.com[/b] and we'll see what we can do!
